dedupe_keys.name: undata united nations statistical databases datamarts with sdmx api

description: UNdata is the United Nations Statistics Division's single entry point to international statistical databases compiled by the UN system and other international agencies. Coverage: all countries and areas; the databases, called datamarts, hold over 60 million data points on themes that include energy, transport, communication, manufacturing, environment, agriculture, population and migration, national accounts, trade, health and education; the Explorer lists 22 databases and 10 table presentations, and the site also links specialised databases outside UNdata such as UN Comtrade, the SDG indicators and Monthly Bulletin of Statistics Online, plus live Statistical Yearbook tables compiled from more than 20 international sources and updated as new data arrive. Format and access: web search, explorer and downloads without login, and a REST and SOAP API built on Eurostat's SDMX Reference Infrastructure for programmatic queries of the datamarts. Licence: UNdata terms of use: all data and metadata are free of charge and may be copied, duplicated and redistributed provided UNdata is cited. Caveats: data are passed through as supplied by the source databases without modification by UNSD, which gives no guarantee of accuracy and revises without notice; the download file formats of individual datamarts were not checked. Simulation uses: country-level energy, transport and population baselines for capacity planning and cross-country comparison in infrastructure models. Related records: UN Comtrade (data-un-comtrade) for trade flows and Eurostat energy statistics (data-eurostat-energy-statistics) for European detail.
